gaps.title: Missing SSO Protocol Support
gaps.jtbd: When authenticating, I want to use OAuth2, OIDC, or LTI, so that SSO works across different standards
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a login request, When the system processes it, Then it should support OAuth2, OIDC, and LTI protocols as specified
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requires 'OAuth2 / OIDC / LTI', but the implementation only supports OAuth2 and LTI. There is no actual OIDC support implemented.
